input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets and largely exceeds our checklist. 19.1 warrants Services (defined in 1.7 to include the hosted software) will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation, with no time limit; 19.2 gives Deliverables a ninety-day conformance warranty and commits the hosted software to conform throughout the subscription term, so both the software (≥90 days / effectively 12 months+) and services (≥30 days / 90 days) durations are satisfied. 19.4 supplies re-performance, repair or replacement plus a refund of Fees paid, so both remedy elements are met, and 19.3 adds compliance with Applicable Law and a malicious-code warranty. 19.5 expressly confirms no disclaimer limits an express warranty, so the disclaimer does not swallow the warranty. The only shortfalls against preferred wording are cosmetic and not worth redlining: the malicious-code warranty is qualified to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor", and the software period is expressed as the subscription term rather than a stated twelve months. No redline proposed.
